subject: Compliance readiness: ISO 27001 scope and FedRAMP evidence mapping
messages:
From: Paul Sanders <paul.sanders@acmehealth.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: audit@threepoint-audit.com, acme-corp-security@acme.com
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 14:12:00 +0000
Subject: Compliance readiness: ISO 27001 scope and FedRAMP evidence mapping

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks for taking this on. Acme Health is starting a combined readiness assessment for ISO 27001 and the FedRAMP/CAIQ questionnaire next quarter. Our external assessor (copied) is leading the evidence collection.

High-level asks:
- Can you confirm Redwood's proposed ISO 27001 scope (production and customer-facing control plane only) and whether the private deployment option (VPC/on-prem) should be in scope?
- We need a mapping from your controls to SOC 2 / CAIQ / SIG fields and a short list of contact owners for each control.
- Can you provide the latest SOC 2 summary and any available artifact timelines (logs, retention, KMS attestations)?

Goal: collect a first tranche of evidence within 3 weeks so the assessor can start sample testing. Attached is the assessor's initial questionnaire list.

Thanks,
Paul Sanders
Head of IT, Acme Health
paul.sanders@acmehealth.com

Attachment: acme-initial-asklist.pdf (pdf)
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Paul Sanders <paul.sanders@acmehealth.com>, audit@threepoint-audit.com
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 16:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Compliance readiness: ISO 27001 scope and FedRAMP evidence mapping

Paul — thanks for the clear ask and timeline. We've started an internal bucket for this. Summary of next steps from Redwood:

1) Scope confirmation: current recommendation is to include production control plane and customer data processing services. Private deployments (VPC/on-prem) are out of scope for Redwood's corporate ISO but we can produce a separate attestation for customer-managed deployments; please confirm whether you want them included.

2) Evidence mapping: attached is an initial evidence_matrix_v0.xlsx with proposed control owners for SOC 2 / CAIQ overlaps. Please review and flag gaps.

3) Artifacts: we'll pull the SOC 2 summary and a subset of audit-ready logs. For FedRAMP-specific asks, we need to confirm which impact level (Low / Moderate) you're assessing; that affects required logging and retention windows.

Can we schedule a 45-min kickoff this week? Proposed slots: Wed 10/11 15:00-15:45 UTC or Thu 11/11 09:00-09:45 UTC.

Attaching: evidence_matrix_v0.xlsx (xlsx) — internal draft.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Manager, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0132
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Paul Sanders <paul.sanders@acmehealth.com>, audit@threepoint-audit.com
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:33:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Compliance readiness: ISO 27001 scope and FedRAMP evidence mapping

Thanks Vanessa — attaching the SOC 2 one-page summary we can share with the assessor. A few clarifications from engineering/security:

- Control owners: I've started populating the evidence_matrix_v0.xlsx with owner names and expected artifacts (cloudtrail logs, KMS rotation records, backup verification).
- KMS: Redwood uses a customer-segregated CMK pattern for dedicated/private deployments; for hosted API we use a multi-tenant KMS with strict access controls — I'll add the KMS diagram to the drive.
- Logs/retention: default retention is 90 days in-house; for FedRAMP Moderate we'll need to configure longer retention (365 days) — that is doable but needs a provisioning change (ticket SEC-847).

Attaching: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (pdf) — contains statement of coverage and report date.

Irene
Senior Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwood.ai
From: ThreePoint Audit <audit@threepoint-audit.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 11:20:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Compliance readiness: ISO 27001 scope and FedRAMP evidence mapping

Vanessa / Irene — appreciate the quick turnaround. A couple of follow-ups based on the SOC summary and notes:

- For sample testing we will need: 1) a 30-day extract of production access logs (authentication events), 2) KMS key rotation history for the past 12 months, and 3) one example incident ticket with timeline and post-mortem. Can you confirm those are available by 11/30?
- Please include documentation describing your retention policy and whether you provide customers with the ability to enforce stricter retention in private deployments.
- For FedRAMP, we need clarification on whether Acme intends to pursue Low or Moderate. If Moderate, there are additional control families around continuous monitoring and configuration baselining.

Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 10:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Compliance readiness: ISO 27001 scope and FedRAMP evidence mapping

Team — next actions and decisions from Redwood:

- Scope: we'll treat Acme's assessment as covering hosted production control plane and customer data processing. We will document a separate attestation for private deployments if Acme needs it.
- Artifacts: we can provide the 30-day auth/access log extract and a 12-month KMS rotation history by 2026-11-29; incident sample will be redacted but available. See JIRA SEC-847 for provisioning work (link below).
- FedRAMP impact level: Paul, can you confirm whether you're targeting Low or Moderate? If Moderate, we'll prioritize baseline configs and increase log retention to 365 days; that will shift some timelines.

I've uploaded our partial responses and the working FedRAMP questionnaire to the shared drive and attached the partial doc here. Please review and mark required clarifications in the drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0A1B2C3D4E5

Attachments: fedramp-questionnaire-partial-response.docx (docx)

Next meeting: provisional slot Fri 13/11 09:00 UTC — let me know if that works.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Manager, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
